teaching.attack-body: When they reach you, press [[key|attack]] and keep at it. They are slow, and they do not stop.
teaching.use-block: Signs, levers and bells on this shore answer when you press [[key|use]] on them.
teaching.use-body: If you want a word with anyone on this shore, stand close and press [[key|use]].

npc/nell.doing: standing in the rain by the jetty mouth with her bad arm tucked into her coat

happening.subject: npc/nell
happening.text: The party comes down to the jetty in the rain, and the ferry-keeper is waiting for someone to ring the bell for her.

happening.subject: npc/nell
happening.text: Nell tells them the ferry only comes for the bell, and what came the last three times it rang.

happening.subject: anchor/notice
happening.text: The ferry notice says how the ferry house is bolted.

happening.subject: anchor/bolt-lever
happening.text: The bolt on the ferry-house door slides back.

objectives.title: Pull the bolt lever by the ferry-house door

happening.subject: anchor/bell
happening.text: The ferry bell rings out over the cove.

objectives.hint: Inside the ferry house, on its stand in the middle of the floor.
objectives.title: Ring the ferry bell

happening.subject: anchor/muster
happening.text: The dead that answered the bell are put back in the water.

happening.subject: npc/nell
happening.text: The shore is quiet again and the ferry is on its way across the sound.

obj/draw-the-bolt.text: The bolt slides back. The ferry-house door is open.

obj/read-the-notice.text: FERRY. Ring the bell once and wait on the jetty. The ferry-house door is bolted from outside: the lever is on the deck beside the door. Never ring after dark.

happening.subject: anchor/muster
happening.text: Across the water the dead come up out of the cove onto the spit and form up, facing the bell.

obj/ring-the-bell.text: Across the water, on the spit, something comes up out of the cove. Then another.
